search.website_text:
Keybound Brawler, typed for you.

Auto Keybound Brawler

Keybound Brawler, typed for you. Built on Dalamud.

---

## What it does Plays the typing for you in **Keybound Brawler**, the Gold Saucer's FINAL FANTASY VII typing event. Press **Start**, queue at the Keybound Registrar in Keybound Square, and the plugin reads the phrases above the enemies and sends the most urgent one in after as long as typing it would take, wave after wave. ## Features - Reads every phrase on screen straight from the game's own UI, no screen capture or OCR. - Two input methods: Submit directly (the default), which sends each word after a typing-length wait and needs no input bar focus, or Type keys, real key presses into the input bar followed by Enter. - With Type keys, keeps the brawler's input bar focused, waking it the way a player does (the first key of the next phrase) whenever it loses focus. It never takes focus from chat or another text box, in the game or in a plugin window, while you are typing there, and never types into one, so a phrase is never sent to chat. - Every key waits for the input bar to show it before the next one goes out, and a wrong or leftover letter is erased with Backspace before Enter is pressed. - Handles the special attacks: types the words over the barrier first during a Barrier Buster, goes after casting enemies next (interruptible ones first), keeps a word going while a debuff hides it, and holds still for Letterlock casts such as Cursed Gaze so your inputs are never locked. - A Target priority setting for everything else: Smart (closest to the barrier first, shortest first once the screen gets crowded), Closest first or Shortest first. A phrase that keeps going in with no visible effect steps aside for a few seconds. - Reads the brawler's own word list from the game, so barrier words, casting enemies and Japanese readings are never guessed from the screen, and words of defeated enemies are skipped. - Auto queue: closes the results, walks to the Keybound registrar (with vnavmesh when installed), registers and accepts the duty, match after match, stopping after a set number of matches or before the 10,000 MGC cap. MGC and MGP earned are tracked per session and in total. - Four typing speeds, from a relaxed 60 words a minute to as fast as the game takes keys. - A humanizer with random reaction pauses before each new phrase and before Enter, both ranges adjustable, plus optional occasional typos that get corrected. All of it can be switched off. - A status card with a progress ring for the phrase being typed and the Letterlock countdown, a live board of the phrases and casts on screen, quick settings beside it, and session stats (phrases, words per minute, time). - Skips the punctuation the game marks as optional (? ! - ') and types Japanese phrases as their hiragana reading. - A single app window with Brawl, Settings, Console, Changelog and About pages, plus a compact header-bar mode. - Every theme from [Glasswork](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/FFXIV-Glasswork), the UI toolkit the window is built on (Neutral, Liquid, Eorzea, Classic, the four Clear themes, Aurora, Catppuccin, Nord and more), dark or light, under Settings, General. The Clear, Liquid, Eorzea and Aurora themes are real glass over the game. - Nine interface languages, picked automatically on first run and changeable under Settings, General. ## Languages English, Français, Deutsch, Türkçe, Español, Português (Brasil), Русский, 日本語, 中文. The plugin picks one on first run from your Dalamud interface language, then your game client, then your OS, falling back to English. Change it any time under **Settings → General → Language**. Phrases are always typed exactly as your game client shows them. ## Install In-game: `/xlsettings` → **Experimental** → paste into **Custom Plugin Repositories**: ``` https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins/main/repo.json ``` Tick **Enabled**, click **+**, then **Save and Close**. Open `/xlplugins` → **All Plugins**, search for **Auto Keybound Brawler**, and install. ## Commands | Command | Action | |---|---| | `/akb` | Toggle the main window | | `/keybound` | Alias for `/akb` | | `/akb start` | Turn auto typing on | | `/akb stop` | Turn auto typing off | | `/akb toggle` | Switch auto typing on or off | | `/akb config` | Open the Settings page | | `/akb log` | Open the Console page | | `/akb changelog` | Open the Changelog page | | `/akb about` | Open the About page | ## Community Questions, ideas, or just want to hang out with other players? Come say hi on Discord. → [Join our Discord](https://discord.gg/hppkAvdBEE) ## More from me If you liked this plugin, take a look at my other Dalamud work. You might find something else there for you. → [XeldarAlz Dalamud Plugins](https://github.com/XeldarAlz/DalamudPlugins) ## License AGPL-3.0-or-later. See [LICENSE.md](LICENSE.md). [NOTICE](NOTICE) adds the attribution terms the AGPL allows: a fork, or any project that reuses this code, must credit the original author and must not pass itself off as the original. The license covers the code, not the name or the icon: read the [trademark and naming policy](TRADEMARK.md) before you publish a fork. How AI is used to build this plugin is written down in [AI usage](AI-USAGE.md).
